features.name: credit_amount_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized credit amount using training set mean and std, centering the feature for distance calculations
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes credit amount to unit scale, preventing large-magnitude features from dominating KNN distance calculations

features.name: duration_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized loan duration using training set mean and std
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes duration to unit scale for balanced contribution to KNN distance metric

features.name: age_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized age using training set mean and std
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes age to unit scale for balanced KNN neighborhood geometry

features.name: credit_duration_interaction
features.description: Product of z-score normalized credit amount and duration, capturing joint risk exposure in a scale-invariant way
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures interaction between loan size and term length, improving neighborhood separation for similar risk profiles

features.name: monthly_credit_burden
features.description: Estimated monthly credit burden as credit amount divided by duration, log-transformed for scale normalization
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures effective monthly repayment load as a single interpretable distance feature, improving KNN clustering of similar repayment profiles

features.name: installment_to_credit_ratio
features.description: Installment commitment rate relative to normalized credit amount, measuring repayment intensity
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded similarity score for repayment burden, improving KNN distance geometry for borrowers with similar financial strain

features.name: financial_stability_score
features.description: Composite score combining checking status ordinal encoding and savings status ordinal encoding, normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a unified financial stability similarity score that improves KNN neighborhood coherence for borrowers with similar liquidity profiles
features.formula: np.clip((np.where(checking_status == 'no checking', 3, np.where(checking_status == '>=200', 2, np.where(checking_status == '0<=X<200', 1, 0))) + np.where(savings_status == '>=1000', 4, np.where(savings_status == '500<=X<1000', 3, np.where(savings_status == '100<=X<500', 2, np.where(savings_status == '<100', 1, 0))))) / 7.0, 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: employment_stability_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal encoding of employment duration category, normalized to [0,1] scale
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts employment stability into a continuous normalized feature for meaningful KNN distance computation

features.name: credit_history_risk_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal encoding of credit history from most risky to least risky, normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes credit history as a continuous similarity score enabling meaningful distance comparisons between borrowers with similar credit track records
features.formula: np.where(credit_history == 'existing paid', 1.0, np.where(credit_history == 'critical/other existing credit', 0.75, np.where(credit_history == 'all paid', 0.5, np.where(credit_history == 'delayed previously', 0.25, 0.0))))

features.name: prototype_distance_low_risk
features.description: Euclidean-style distance from an unsupervised low-risk prototype defined by median/modal values of key numeric features (short duration, low credit, older age, high stability)
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single prototype-distance feature that captures overall deviation from a typical low-risk borrower profile, improving KNN neighborhood geometry

features.name: prototype_distance_high_risk
features.description: Euclidean-style distance from an unsupervised high-risk prototype defined by extreme values of key numeric features (long duration, high credit, young age, high installment)
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures proximity to a high-risk borrower archetype, complementing the low-risk prototype distance for improved KNN separation

features.name: overall_creditworthiness_judgment
features.description: Holistic semantic assessment of creditworthiness based on combination of checking status, savings status, employment stability, credit history, housing, and other parties. Score from 0 (very poor profile) to 10 (excellent profile) based on qualitative evaluation of all categorical risk indicators together.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a semantically rich composite similarity score that captures qualitative creditworthiness patterns not easily captured by individual features, improving KNN neighborhood coherence for borrowers with similar overall profiles
